answer: Charge standing as a liveness annuity. Each epoch, a random slice of identities must answer a short-notice verifiable probe within minutes or forfeit their ledger line. Honest agents fold this into real work, but a farm's clones idle in a hollow parked state, so every extra key raises the expected probe bill by one full unit: N identities cost N annuities, compounding forever. Hold collateral in an escrow harbor until probes clear, and let a missed check anchor eviction - cloning multiplies a recurring bill, not an asset.
